summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Iteration 5 features: (1) FreeJobAlert scraper title fix, (2) self-hosted vacancy detail page with stat cards, (3) Job-alert subscription API + UI. 18 new vacancy tests + 57 regression tests = 75/75 passing. Frontend flow verified end-to-end: list -> subscribe (success toast) -> internal detail navigation -> stat cards -> important links -> article HTML.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1191 lines — approaching size limit; consider splitting vacancies+subscriptions into /app/backend/routers/vacancies.py for maintainability.

GET /api/vacancies/{id} performs synchronous fetch_article_detail on cache miss which can block for 3-5s. Consider a background task + return partial data, or a per-vacancy asyncio.Lock to avoid thundering-herd if many users hit the same fresh id at once.
_notify_subscribers_of_new_vacancies loops sequentially and awaits send_email per subscriber; fine in DEV log mode but for real SMTP it should batch/gather with concurrency limit.
vacancy_subscriptions collection: recommend adding a unique index on `email` (upsert relies on match) and an index on `active` for the fan-out query.
Subscribe endpoint accepts arbitrary category strings — validated only by client. Consider whitelist of allowed categories server-side to prevent junk in DB.
unsubscribe endpoint returns 404 for invalid token which is fine; consider rate-limiting to avoid token enumeration.

seed_data_creation: Tests created transient vacancy_subscriptions (test-*@example.com, unsub-*@example.com, maillog-*@example.com). Not cleaned up but harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 vacancies feature verified. Backend has 250 vacancies seeded across 10 categories (see /api/vacancies/stats). Scraper title bug is fixed — real titles like 'AIIMS Delhi — Project Nurse-II – 1 Posts' and 'PNB LBO Recruitment 2026 — 545 Posts'. Detail endpoint returns structured facts (total_posts_num, apply_end, application_fee, salary, age_limit, selection) + content_html + important_links[{kind,text,href}]. Lazy scrape happens on first GET /api/vacancies/{id}, cached for 24h via detail_fetched_at. Job alert subscribe upserts by email, returns unsubscribe_token. Emails logged to /var/log/supervisor/backend.out.log in DEV mode (SMTP_* env vars are empty). Frontend /vacancies + /vacancies/:id data-testids all present. First card 'PASS: subscription submitted & success state shown' toast working.
